scripts.prepare:www: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('www',{recursive:true,force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); ['index.html','styles.css','config.js','data.js','map.js','privacy.js','admin.js','app.js','sw.js','privacy.html','icon-512.png'].forEach(f=>{ if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f,'www/'+f); }); console.log('Prepared www/ OK');"
